WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT id, event_type, event_time,
         LAG(event_type) OVER (ORDER BY event_time, id) AS prev_type
  FROM away_events
), filtered AS (
  SELECT id, event_type, event_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='away' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           OVER (ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS trip_no
  FROM ordered
  WHERE prev_type IS NULL OR prev_type <> event_type
), trips AS (
  SELECT trip_no,
         MIN(CASE WHEN event_type='away' THEN event_time END) AS start_time,
         MAX(CASE WHEN event_type='home' THEN event_time END) AS end_time
  FROM filtered WHERE trip_no > 0 GROUP BY trip_no
), t AS (
  SELECT trip_no, start_time, end_time,
         TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, COALESCE(end_time, NOW())) AS duration_sec
  FROM trips
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN start_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND duration_sec >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM t

WITH RECURSIVE days AS (  SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) AS d  UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM days WHERE d < CURDATE()), ordered AS (  SELECT id, event_type, event_time,         LAG(event_type) OVER (ORDER BY event_time, id) AS prev_type  FROM away_events), filtered AS (  SELECT id, event_type, event_time,         SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='away' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)           OVER (ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS trip_no  FROM ordered WHERE prev_type IS NULL OR prev_type <> event_type), trips AS (  SELECT trip_no,         MIN(CASE WHEN event_type='away' THEN event_time END) AS start_time,         MAX(CASE WHEN event_type='home' THEN event_time END) AS end_time  FROM filtered WHERE trip_no > 0 GROUP BY trip_no), t AS (  SELECT trip_no, start_time, end_time,         TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, COALESCE(end_time, NOW())) AS duration_sec  FROM trips) SELECT CONVERT_TZ(days.d, '+08:00', '+00:00') AS time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE DATE(t.start_time) = days.d AND t.duration_sec >= 600) AS `有效次数`, ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,   GREATEST(t.start_time, days.d),   LEAST(COALESCE(t.end_time, NOW()), DATE_ADD(days.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY))))), 0)   FROM t) / 3600, 2) AS `出门时长(h)` FROM days ORDER BY days.d
